tasks.short: Design and deliver assistive technology for people with disabilities

steps.what: Establish functional needs and physical constraints with the person and relevant care professionals
Design technology and evaluate prototypes against individual needs, mechanical constraints and observed performance
Check the delivered device with its user and explain use, limitations and follow-up

tasks.design: Keep individual requirements, device design and delivery checking with the engineer, using {DOCS} and an {OTHER} assistive-device engineering environment. Existing design tools support the work, while the engineer and user evaluate actual function before the checked device is handed over.
tasks.previous_blocker: Individual anatomy, daily activities and preferences cannot be reduced to a generic device template.
tasks.enabler_now: Digital design supports engineering, but this digest gives no demonstrated saving for individual assistive-device design and delivery.
tasks.still_hard: A mechanically plausible design may be uncomfortable, impractical or unsuitable during real use.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer understands the person's goals and reconciles technical performance with lived experience.
tasks.altitude: Design judgement, user contact and delivery responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Assess how an assistive device supports daily activities

evidence.claim: Retaining individual assessment, engineering design and device handover is a model-knowledge boundary; general simulation tools do not establish savings or suitability for an individual device.

assumptions: Boundary is the engineer's assessment, design and handover, not separate fabrication or clinical approval. User participation and care-professional labour are outside the focal denominator and receive no saving.
The engineer captures needs and measurements in fully retained s1; prototype observations arise during s2 evaluation. No ready structured suitability or fit flag is presumed.

Fabrication staff produce the manufactured device after the evaluated design is available and before s3. Their work remains unchanged and is not transferred by this design; missing evidence or poor fit returns to manual assessment and redesign.
Test existing engineering functions before custom code. OTHER denotes assistive-device design and evaluation software.
No new system or capture obligation is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero. Separate clinical or quality approvals must still follow the organisation's existing process.
unknowns: Device type and professional responsibility boundaries
research_questions: Which device limitations appear only during direct observation of daily use?

already_counted.description: Individual requirements, engineering evaluation and checked handover

incremental.description: No additional automation or capture upkeep

approvals.approved_version: Exact device identity, evaluated design version, checked configuration and user instructions verified in s3; modifications require renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net are zero with zero added upkeep. Individual assessment, prototype reasoning and delivery checks keep their full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise manufacturing staff on bioproduction problems

steps.what: Investigate fermentation, filtration or other process problems using observations, batch evidence and staff accounts
Advise manufacturing staff on causes, uncertainty and appropriate next investigations or proposed changes

tasks.design: Keep investigation and advice with the engineer using batch evidence in {OPS_SYSTEM} and controlled information in {DOCS}. The engineer discusses uncertainty with manufacturing staff; advice does not automatically change production settings or authorise product release.
tasks.previous_blocker: Similar symptoms can reflect different biological, equipment or operating causes.
tasks.enabler_now: Digital batch evidence helps investigation, but the supplied digest does not establish that a new assistant can replace this technical conversation.
tasks.still_hard: The relevant cause may be absent from recorded variables and require new observations or experiments.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer questions assumptions with operators and separates evidence from a plausible explanation.
tasks.altitude: Advice responsibility and direct manufacturing collaboration remain unchanged.

reach.task: Describe process symptoms and constraints during a production problem

evidence.claim: Human investigation and context-sensitive bioproduction advice remain a model-knowledge boundary; no task-specific labour saving is established in this digest.

assumptions: Boundary is investigation and advice, not implementation of a process change or release of a batch.

Operators and existing instruments produce batch records and observations. The engineer interprets times, operating conditions, deviations and source limitations in fully counted s1, without assuming a ready root-cause code.

Additional observations and manufacturing responses arise during the investigation and conversation, with all engineer enquiry and interpretation retained. Missing records lead to manual discussion and further investigation.
Test native record access before considering custom software; this proposal introduces no new data processing.
Incremental upkeep is zero because there is no new tool, record requirement or transferred activity.
research_questions: Which problem causes cannot be distinguished from existing batch records alone?

already_counted.description: Investigation, technical checking and manufacturing discussion

approvals.approved_version: Exact advice, batch context, evidence limits and intended recipients checked before communication in s2; changed advice requires fresh checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0 and incremental=0. Investigation and technical discussion remain unchanged; automatic batch logging is existing system runtime.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review manufacturing yield and variation with checked statistical views

steps.what: Define comparable manufacturing batches and verify yield, measurements, conditions and exclusions
Prepare yield and process variation calculations and comparative views from the checked dataset
Review existing processes, test explanations and identify supported opportunities for yield improvement

tasks.design: Configure repeatable yield and variation views in {BI} from a dataset the engineer has checked against {OPS_SYSTEM}. Keep batch comparability, interpretation and improvement hypotheses with the engineer; the views do not diagnose causes or change the process.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated preparation of comparable calculations distracted from investigating why performance differed.
tasks.enabler_now: Native analytical views can rerun fixed calculations from a checked dataset and explicit analysis specification.
tasks.still_hard: Apparent variation may arise from measurement differences, changing inputs or unrecorded operating conditions.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer distinguishes a useful experiment from an unjustified causal conclusion.
tasks.altitude: Less time goes into repeated calculation preparation; experimental and process decisions remain unchanged.

reach.task: Assess measurement comparability before interpreting process variation
reach.learn: Measurement systems and appropriate statistical assumptions

evidence.claim: Configured yield and variation calculations from checked batch data are a model-knowledge design; no measured biomedical process-review saving is supplied.

assumptions: Boundary is data preparation and review to improvement hypotheses, not implementing changes, qualifying a process or claiming increased yield.

Operators and instruments produce batch id, input quantity, accepted output quantity, units, sample time, process measurements and operating context in their normal records. Existing capture and runtime are not credited as savings.

The engineer verifies units, missing values, batch comparability, exclusions and calculation definitions in fully retained s1, producing the checked dataset and analysis specification before s2. No ready discrepancy or comparable-batch flag is presumed.
s2 applies only specified formulas and groupings. Missing fields or uncertain measurement definitions return to manual capture and investigation in s1; absent repeatable calculations leave s2 manual.
Test existing analytical configuration before custom code. Keep changed measurement mappings and operator clarification in the explicit upkeep allowances.
unknowns: Whether repeatable calculations are currently prepared manually
Batch data comparability and measurement quality
research_questions: Can native views reproduce checked yield calculations without hiding exclusions or unit differences?

already_counted.description: Capture analysis definitions and verify comparable source data
Interpret results and develop process hypotheses

incremental.description: Maintain measurement mappings and statistical view definitions
Manufacturing or quality staff clarify changed measurement records

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=75; gross 25 minus 8 focal upkeep gives central net 17. Range covers already-configured calculations versus limited repeated preparation; comparability checks and causal interpretation remain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop bioremediation processes through evidence and experiments

steps.what: Develop bioremediation processes through biological analysis, experimental trials and evaluation of environmental performance

tasks.design: Keep process development and experimental interpretation with the engineer using evidence in {DOCS} and the {OTHER} biological process research environment. Existing analysis tools support trials, while environmental performance and limitations are established through representative observations.
tasks.previous_blocker: Biological treatment depends on contaminants, organisms and site conditions that vary between applications.
tasks.enabler_now: Research tools assist analysis, but this digest offers no demonstrated replacement for bioremediation process development.
tasks.still_hard: Laboratory removal of a pollutant may not establish safe or effective performance in the intended environment.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer designs discriminating experiments and recognises unintended consequences or unsupported extrapolation.
tasks.altitude: Research responsibility and development time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Evaluate treatment performance under representative site conditions
reach.learn: Environmental endpoints and limits of laboratory extrapolation

evidence.claim: Retaining biological process development and experimental interpretation is a model-knowledge boundary; generic simulation or writing capability does not establish a saving here.

assumptions: Boundary ends at a process proposal, not environmental authorisation, operational deployment or routine treatment.

Existing studies and site staff provide initial evidence and constraints. The engineer and laboratory staff produce new trial observations during development; interpretation and engineer enquiry remain fully counted in s1.
No structured treatment-effective or environmentally safe flag is presumed. Missing or contradictory evidence leads to manual investigation and further experiments.
Test existing analysis functions before any custom project. OTHER denotes biological process research and laboratory analysis software.
No new automation, integration or record requirement is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero.
research_questions: Which treatment effects require field evidence beyond laboratory observations?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net are zero with no incremental upkeep. Experimental development and interpretation retain full time; no clerical substitution is assumed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Repeated yield calculations may take less preparation, while assistive design, process advice and experimental development retain human responsibility.
reach: Learn user outcomes from rehabilitation colleagues
Work with quality engineers on measurement comparability
role.ambitious_version: An engineer who connects measured process behaviour and individual needs with clearly bounded technical conclusions.
